bioconda.name: polars-bio
bioconda.summary: Blazing fast genomic operations on large Python dataframes
bioconda.description:
polars-bio is a Python library for genomics built on top of Polars,
Apache Arrow and Apache DataFusion. It provides a DataFrame API for
genomics data and is designed to be fast, memory efficient and easy
to use.

Key features:
  - Popular genomic interval operations with a DataFrame API
  - SQL-powered querying of bioinformatics data
  - Native parallel engine powered by Apache DataFusion
  - Out-of-core / streaming processing
  - Reading from cloud storage
  - Zero-copy data exchange with Apache Arrow
  - Support for VCF, BAM, CRAM, SAM, FASTQ, FASTA, BED, GFF, GTF and
    BigWig/BigBed

commands: python -c "import polars as pl, polars_bio as pb; d1 = pl.DataFrame((pl.Series('chrom', ('chr1','chr1','chr2')), pl.Series('start', (100,500,100)), pl.Series('end', (200,600,200)))); d2 = pl.DataFrame((pl.Series('chrom', ('chr1','chr2')), pl.Series('start', (150,900)), pl.Series('end', (250,1000)))); d1.config_meta.set(coordinate_system_zero_based=False); d2.config_meta.set(coordinate_system_zero_based=False); r = pb.overlap(d1, d2, output_type='polars.DataFrame'); assert r.height == 1, r; assert r.get_column('chrom_1').item() == 'chr1', r; assert r.get_column('start_1').item() == 100, r; assert r.get_column('start_2').item() == 150, r; print('overlap smoke test passed')"
